title: Offline Email Export?
creator: stealthyninga
content:
Device info: Phone: Samsung Galaxy S20 5G App version: 24.0 Android: 13 One UI: 5.1

Background: I have an account setup with IMAP. This morning, on my desktop version of Thunderbird, I made the mistake of clicking something I thought would empty my trash. Instead, whatever I clicked deleted the contents of every folder within my account. Despite immediately hitting ALT+F4, I confirmed that all the messages and templates have been removed from the server as well.

While I instantly started to panic, I had the state of mind to think to turn my phone on airplane mode to try and my luck I did save some emails! I have auto sync turned off in my settings, but I have my phone offline just in case.

I managed to recover almost all of my emails from my server backup that ran yesterday. However, I am missing all emails from today and from last night. Lucky again, I have those on my phone!

Question: Is there a way for me to export copies of select emails to save as backup without connecting my phone to the internet?
